Caller and user-visible result: The page passes the flow's reason and blocked-attempt notice into the composer, whose keydown handler consumes only allowed submissions or blockers with a reason and renders that notice as a status message. | | **Findings** | None | None. | | **Security** | None | None. | ## How this fits together The New Session Control UI turns a draft, selected target, and Gateway state into a session-creation request. Its submission flow supplies both the Start controls and composer keyboard handling, so a blocker must produce a visible reason instead of silently suppressing the action. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Draft and selected target] --> B[New Session submission flow] B --> C[Submission gate evaluation] C -->|Allowed| D[Create session] C -->|Blocked with reason| E[Record blocked attempt] E --> F[Composer status notice] C -->|Silent gate| G[Native keyboard behavior] ``` ## Before merge - [ ] **Resolve merge risk (P1)** - The branch is behind current main and its aggregate CI gate is currently failing; revalidate the merge result on the exact head before landing. - [ ] **Resolve merge risk (P1)** - Production code is net +198 lines for a bug fix; the shared resolver is the justified canonical owner, but its gate list should remain the only submission-policy source. - [ ] **Complete next step (P2)** - No mechanical repair is outstanding; this maintainer-owned PR needs normal exact-head CI and merge review.

Land only after an exact-head green validation confirms the merge result. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Yes—source inspection on current main shows Enter returns early whenever canSubmit is false, while several canSubmit blockers have no disabled reason; the precise live timing race was not executed in this read-only review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? Yes—the shared gate resolver is the narrowest maintainable fix because it makes the boolean decision, tooltip reason, and keyboard feedback derive from one owner rather than maintaining parallel lists.
